name: EURO3
oneLiner: EURO3 is 3A DAO's overcollateralized euro stablecoin, minted on Polygon and Linea against whitelisted crypto and stablecoin collateral in user-owned vaults.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: 3A documents EURO3 as minted through collateralized vault loans and burned on repayment or redemption. That live stabilization path is a CDP mechanism, not issuer cash issuance or a NAV fund share; its reference remains the euro rather than the U.S. dollar.

collateral: Whitelisted crypto and stablecoin collateral in 3A Vaults on Polygon and Linea, including USDC.e, DAI, WETH/ETH, USDT, WBTC, wstETH, and other wrapped or yield-bearing assets depending on chain
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized vault minting and redemption: users mint EURO3 loans against approved collateral, repay debt to burn EURO3, and can redeem EURO3 against vault collateral when the protocol's redemption conditions are met

oracleRisk.summary: EURO3's five residual debt-bearing Polygon collateral branches divide a heartbeat-checked Chainlink token/USD value by a heartbeat-checked Chainlink EUR/USD value. Every leaf enforces a 24-hour staleness bound and reverts on failure; no fallback or last-good cache exists, and all branches share the same EUR/USD Chainlink failure domain.

branchApplicability.rationale: At Polygon block 90225687, the complete TokenToPriceFeed event history contained ten registered collateral tokens and all ten collateral caps were zero. Traversing all 125 current-factory vaults found debt only in WMATIC, USDC.e, WETH, QNT, and USDT vaults. SUSHI, DAI, LINK, PAXG, and UNI had zero debt and zero cap. The still-authorized legacy Polygon factory had seven vaults but zero total debt and a zero debt ceiling. At Linea block 31370307, all 585 current-factory vaults had zero debt and every documented collateral cap was zero, so Linea is an explicit inactive exclusion rather than a live oracle branch.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-08 across both tracked deployments. At Polygon block 91675721, EURO3 0xa0e4c84693266a9d3bbef2f394b33712c76599ab returned owner 0xb3857f86a95516902c953d530d3e5c29b1518a85; at Linea block 31656728, EURO3 0x3f817b28da4940f018c6b5c0a11c555ebb1264f9 returned owner 0x1ba31e955a3e1fbc8caffa64056c58a3e4d86082. Both retained direct non-proxy code and zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots. Sourcify exact-match MintableToken source is OpenZeppelin ERC-20 plus onlyOwner mint and has no pause, blacklist, freeze, allowlist, seizure, arbitrary-holder burn, or transfer hook. The owner chain can change minters but cannot change deployed transfer logic, so direct blacklistability is false. Freezeable collateral remains backing risk only.

mintAuthority.summary: EURO3 on Polygon and Linea uses a MintableToken + MintableTokenOwner pattern. Authorized vault contracts (VaultFactory 0x47608470... and a second contract) are registered as minters in MintableTokenOwner and call mint() on the token. The MintableTokenOwner is owned by an OwnerProxy, which is owned by a single EOA (0x84d28251143df55df1768870fc26983f50364557) — no multisig. This EOA can add/revoke minters and transfer control unilaterally, making this a concentrated-admin posture.

controls.label: 3A VaultFactory and VaultCore contracts (authorized minters)
controls.capDescription: Minters registered in MintableTokenOwner; actual mint bounded by per-vault overcollateralization against whitelisted collateral on each chain.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 88325316: minters(0x4760847023fa0833221ae76e01db1e483a5d20e0)=true (VaultFactory, verified on Blockscout) and minters(0x027a597ad044bddb7a6b7ef9ed2b641122801220)=true confirmed via f46eccc4 selector on MintableTokenOwner (0xb3857f86...). Both registered via MinterAdded events (on-chain logs). VaultFactory code confirmed as contract (len=37034). Linea (0x027a597...) has same structure; minters not independently enumerated but pattern is parallel.

controls.label: 3A DAO operator EOA (ultimate minting authority)
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 88325316: EURO3 MintableToken (0xa0e4c84...) owner()=MintableTokenOwner (0xb3857f86...). MintableTokenOwner owner()=OwnerProxy (0xdfeeed605b30d801b19328b1a2053b7f64baedee). OwnerProxy slot0=EOA 0x84d28251143df55df1768870fc26983f50364557 (code returns empty = EOA). Same EOA owns Linea OwnerProxy (0xc5241aadbd49e3e53dc6549cb7ba24e9d3559826). OwnerProxy controls addMinter/revokeMinter on MintableTokenOwner; no Safe or multisig in the ownership chain.

review.evidence: At Polygon block 88325316 / Linea block 30997860: EURO3 MintableToken (Polygon 0xa0e4c84..., Linea 0x3f817b28...) is a non-proxied OZ Ownable contract whose owner is a MintableTokenOwner contract. MintableTokenOwner source (verified on Blockscout) has mint()/addMinter()/revokeMinter() functions. Authorized minters: VaultFactory (0x4760847023fa0833221ae76e01db1e483a5d20e0, minters()=true) and 0x027a597ad044bddb7a6b7ef9ed2b641122801220 (minters()=true). MintableTokenOwner.owner()=OwnerProxy (0xdfeeed605b30...) whose slot0=EOA 0x84d28251143df55df1768870fc26983f50364557 (eth_getCode=empty). Same EOA controls both Polygon and Linea deployments. No multisig in minting chain; posture upgraded to concentrated-admin.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: EURO3 has no cross-chain bridge route. It is minted natively and independently on each chain (Polygon and Linea) by 3A's local CDP vault contracts: supply is created when users open EURO3 loans against that chain's whitelisted collateral and burned when they repay or redeem. Both token contracts are verified as a plain MintableToken (ERC20, Ownable) exposing only mint()/burn(), with the owner being a per-chain MintableTokenOwner that registers that chain's VaultFactory/vault minters. There is no OFT/CCIP/NTT/Hyperlane/Axelar or any cross-chain function in either contract, and the deployments use different addresses (ruling out deterministic omnichain-token patterns), so each chain's supply carries no cross-chain dependency. Holders can move EURO3 via third-party aggregators (Symbiosis, MetaMask Bridge, etc.), but that is not the durable issuance/supply path.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The live balances are held in 3A VaultFactory-linked smart contracts on Polygon and Linea rather than with a conventional custodian. The reviewed contract/documentation surfaces do not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms; contract integrity and governance are the operative custody failure domains.
